missions.page_title: Timeblock Missions - complete missions to earn internal points
missions.heading: Missions
missions.intro: Complete daily missions, brand partner missions, and time-limited missions to earn Timeblock internal points. Internal points can be used under platform rules for member events, AI chat allowance, and selected redemption items.
missions.points_notice: Internal points are only used inside the Timeblock platform. They have no cash value, are not an e-wallet or investment asset, and cannot be withdrawn, resold, or redeemed for cash.
missions.empty_body: Change the language, region, or end-time filter, or check back later for new Timeblock missions.
events.page_title: Timeblock Event Center - platform, business, and member events
events.meta_description: Timeblock Event Center brings together official events, business partner events, and member events. Members can join under event rules or use internal points for event tickets.
events.title: Timeblock Event Center
events.intro: Explore Timeblock official events, business partner events, and member events. Members can join under event rules or use internal points for tickets; businesses can publish brand events, ticket events, and TBQR scan events through a Business plan.
events.business_cta: Want to publish events? View Business plans
events.empty_body: Change the language, source, region, or end-time filter, or check back later for new Timeblock events.
events.business_title: Want to publish events on Timeblock?
events.business_body: With a Business plan, companies can create brand events, member missions, ticket events, and TBQR entry points while tracking participation records and event performance.
shop.page_title: Timeblock Shop - platform, business, and member content
shop.meta_description: Timeblock Shop shows platform content, linked business products, and member content. It provides information and outbound links only; it does not process checkout or create platform orders.
shop.title: Timeblock Shop
shop.intro: Explore the platform and join the ecosystem to find and reference products from linked members and businesses.
shop.empty_body: Change the language, source, region, or end-time filter, or check back later for new Timeblock featured products.
shop.business_title: Bring your products into Timeblock Shop
shop.business_body: Businesses can submit featured products, brand event products, or affiliate content through a Business plan and connect them with missions, events, and TBQR entry points to increase participation.
redeem.page_title: Timeblock Internal Points Shop - redeem selected items with internal points
redeem.title: Internal Points Shop
redeem.intro: Use Timeblock internal points to redeem selected items or member gifts. Availability depends on platform announcements, stock, and redemption rules. Internal points have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn, resold, or redeemed for cash.
redeem.empty_body: Change the language, region, or end-time filter, or check back later for new redemption items.
empty.missions: No missions are available for this language yet.
empty.events: No events are available for this language yet.
empty.shop: No products are available for this language yet.
wallet.points_notice: Internal points are platform-only benefits and activity ledger records. They have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn.
wallet.fgo_notice: Internal FGO is an internal governance benefit balance, not an investment asset.
auth.login.title: Timeblock member login | Member center
auth.login.heading: Log in to the Timeblock member platform
auth.login.intro: After logging in, you can view internal points, AI Chat allowance, mission records, event tickets, and redemption progress.
auth.login.note: Use your registered member account to log in.
auth.register.title: Timeblock member registration | Join member platform
auth.register.heading: Join the Timeblock member platform
auth.register.intro: After registering, you can complete missions, join member events, use AI Chat, and explore curated partner items and internal-point redemptions.
auth.register.login_link: Already have an account? Log in
auth.register.turnstile_missing: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth.register.registration_open: Member account creation is currently available.
auth.forgot.title: Timeblock forgot password | Reset member password
auth.forgot.heading: Reset member password
auth.forgot.intro: Enter your registered email and the system will send a password reset link. To protect accounts, this page will not reveal whether the email is registered.
auth.forgot.note: Reset links expire. Do not forward them to anyone else.
auth.reset.title: Timeblock password reset | Set new password
auth.reset.heading: Set a new password
auth.reset.intro: Create a new member password. After finishing, log in again with the new password.
auth.reset.note: A password reset link can be used only once.
auth.verify.title: Timeblock Pro | Email verification
auth.verify.heading: Email verification
auth.verify.intro: After verification, members can use Timeblock missions, events, Chat, and internal-point redemption features.
auth.verify.note: If the verification link has expired, log in to the member center to resend the verification email.
auth.verify_sent.title: Timeblock Pro | Confirm your Email
auth.verify_sent.heading: Confirm your Email
auth.verify_sent.intro: We sent a verification email to {email}. After Email verification, you can use Chat, missions, events, and internal-point redemption features.
auth.verify_sent.status: The verification email has been created. If you do not receive it, log in and resend it from the member center.
auth.verify_sent.note: Email verification is part of the Timeblock commercial account trust flow and helps reduce spam accounts and event abuse.
auth.error.invalid_login: The login details are not correct. Please check and try again.
auth.error.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.error.password_mismatch: The two password entries do not match.
auth.error.email_registered: This Email is already registered. Please log in.
auth.register.review_status: Registration details are incomplete. Please fix the highlighted issue.
auth.turnstile.missing_secret: Cloudflare Turnstile secret is not configured, so registration verification cannot be completed.
auth.turnstile.network_error: Cloudflare Turnstile verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth.turnstile.failed: Cloudflare Turnstile verification failed. Please try again.
auth.notify.member_registered_body: A new member registered: {email}. Please check Email verification status.
auth.verify.success: Email verification is complete. Please log in to the member center.
auth.forgot.status: If this Email is registered, the system will send a password reset link. Please check your inbox.
auth.reset.success: Password updated. Please log in with the new password.
